reviews.t: Brings the milkshakes to my yard!
reviews.x: Best beard balm that I have come across. Leaves my unruly beard soft and manageable. Plus, the scent alerts women from all over the county and they in turn bring me baked goods to celebrate my manliness and soft beard.  Don't delay, buy today.

Having long given up finding appropriate product for my beard, I bought a tin of Beard Balm Leave-in Conditioner (BBLIC) by Premium Nature on a lark. (Impulse shopping. Darn you, Amazon lightning deals!) Nonetheless, I've applied BBLIC every two or three days for a couple of weeks -- not long enough to render a final opinion but long enough to assess the primary attributes and contrast this product with others that I've tried.  BBLIC is effectively unscented. The initial light orange-citrus scen
It smells great, not overwhelming. My husbands beard is so much softer now. I can rub and snuggle his face now without having those coarse beard hairs poking me. I'll definitely buy again. :)

I've used better. I've used worse. Didn't seem to have much holding power. The citrus scent it too strong in my opinion. A man's beard should smell manly. Like a forest or whiskey and cigars or flannel shirts. The scent comes across as a heavily diluted bath and body Works spray

If you’re looking for something for your beard, go with the Old Amish beard balm. Originally, I rated this as three stars, how ever after finishing it up and going back to old Amish, I realized even more so it's just bad beard balm...

reviews.t: Not for sensitive skin or if you have sulfate allergies
reviews.x: I’m sure the product works fine for most people, but if you have sensitive skin then I wouldn’t recommend this. The Balm is 100% natural but the high content of essential oils made my face itch after 10 minutes of application.

reviews.t: Great conditioner. Keep your beard happy.
reviews.x: When you start getting a decent beard you realize the value of beard balms and oils. After you shampoo your beard you basically strip it of oils and dirt. That is good but you have to replace the oils if you don't want the dreaded beard itch and dandruff. This stuff does a great job at replacing the striped oils. It keeps my beard happy and that helps keep me happy. I also enjoy the sent of this balm. It is a mild sent of citrus orange in my opinion. I have used others with less sent and some th

Well , I got to say that I am pleasantly surprised by this balm . I have a very thick beard and find that most balms are very dense and can take forever to work into the hair . Not this stuff , very lite to the feel and only takes a minute to work into my beard . The scent is a very light citrus . And it has left my beard all kinds of soft . This has become my daily beard balm .

reviews.t: Every man needs to tame his beard
reviews.x: First time using any beard products as I've never had a beard before. Saw several recommendations for a balm to tame one, and saw this on lightning deals. Seems like the perfect accoutrement to a mans grooming regiment. Lightweight, slight citrus scent, and does exactly as advertised. Will buy again!

reviews.t: Smells great though. Hopefully I remember to edit come November
reviews.x: ONLY GAVE ONE STAR BECAUSE HE HASN'T TRIED IT::  Bought for my my boyfriend to try but because he's a police officer, he cant grow his beard in until No Shave November.  I'll come back and edit this once he's used it.  Smells great though. Hopefully I remember to edit come November.
Smooth and easy transaction. So far I have used the product for about a week and I'm enjoying it. Nice smell but not overpowering and probably more scentless. Nice look and cool little cannister.
I bought this for my son who says it smells like a urinal.  I say it smells like the zoo.  It really isn't a wax but has a creamy texture.  he didn't like it and threw it away.

I'll start by saying, I am an African American male and this Balm from Premium Nature is NICE! The smell isn't too strong like some other balms and it's more light weight than another balm I've bought. I have used up all my brothers balm in the past 2 months so I was forced to order my own lol. In short, this stuff works! I don't really have a big beard, I have a short beard that often grows and curls up but with this balm you can grown a "proper" beard and reduce the curling.  Here are

reviews.t: A great tool in the beard taming tool kit..
reviews.x: I got this for my husband because he's always looking for new ways to tame the beast that is his beard. He has only used it a few times but says it's definitely making his beard a little easier to comb through and I have to admit I like the smell. It's not a very strong smell but it almost has a citrus like scent...kind of smells like oranges but not quite. I think we'll definitely be purchasing again when this can is gone.

reviews.t: Birthday gift for a bearded husband
reviews.x: I got this Beard Balm as a birthday gift for my husband. He LOVES it! The smell is a very mild orange scent and natural since it is essential oil based. So it's not overpowering. The texture is good, not greasy. He uses a pea sized amount as directed after a shower. It helps his beard look softer and more conditioned. We even like the design of the vintage inspired tin. All around great product! Would buy again.

reviews.t: I like the feel of this balm
reviews.x: I like the feel of this balm. It keeps my beard soft throughout the day without it being overly oily. It is all natural and definitely feels that way. The only thing I wish was different is that it had a more appealing smell. It doesn't have a bad smell, but it isn't particularly pleasing. It is just kind of normal/odorless. I would prefer it to have an appealing smell for something going right under my nose.

reviews.t: Great product for styling and softening your beard
reviews.x: I used just beard oil before and it got to be a pain to reapply it a couple times a day. Once I used this beard balm I knew I wouldn't got back to the oil. It makes my beard softer than the oil and makes styling my beard much easier giving it a much neater look. I highly recommend this product and will definitely buy it again when the tin runs out.

We bought another brand from Amazon previously and my husband and I both HATED the smell. This only has an extremely mild scent and is very pleasant. It seems to help keep my husband's thick, wild beard well as well. We will be back!

I love this beard balm!!! I've tried several other brands, but none of them feel the way this one does. It is so easily applied and leaves my beard and face feeling wonderful! Very nice subtle scent. My girlfriend loves it too!

reviews.t: The packaging is nice a heavy duty tin with a screw on top ...
reviews.x: I ordered this for my son. The packaging is nice a heavy duty tin with a screw on top that is easy open and close. The product has a very light lemony scent that is not over powering. My son loves it! Will purchase again.

Bought it for my brother for his birthday since he's been growing a beard, he loves it and says it's saved his life haha. Im not sure I'd go that far haha but I'll be back to buy one whenever I do grow out a beard myself.

I have been looking for a product to help with my dry skin under my beard and this product has worked perfectly! Highly recommend even if you aren't experiencing dry skin. Makes your beard very soft and very comfortable.

I give this balm a 3 only because it says use a PEA size amount. You definitely need a bit more to get good results. Other than that it leaves my chaotic beard soft and manageable. I would but this product again.

I don't use this myself because I'm not a bearded lady but I have 3 grown boys, two with beards and they love how soft and manageable this conditioner makes their beard feels. I think they look very nice.

reviews.t: Easy to apply and does what it's supposed to
reviews.x: It's ok... Easy to apply and does what it's supposed to, but the scent is not my favorite.  I'm finding that I like the smell less and less the more that I use it and probably would not purchase again.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the scent as light and not overpowering, often describing it as a mild citrus or orange aroma.
Many customers report the balm leaves beards softer and easier to manage or comb.
Several reviewers describe the product as lightweight and easy to work into the beard.
A few reviewers criticize the scent, calling it too strong, unmanly, or unpleasant.
Some users report weak holding power or find the balm generally inferior to other beard balms.
